nodes.label: Notifications
nodes.rationale: Email alerts for a student below the attendance threshold, a cancelled lecture, a substitute, lectures nobody marked, and shift-change requests.

nodes.label: Notification outbox
nodes.rationale: Everything goes through one outbox so a trigger never sends mail from inside a web request and a failed SMTP server never loses a message. The row is inserted on the cursor of the change and commits with it. The worker claims the oldest queued row whose available_at has passed, using the same locked_by and heartbeat_at claim as the other queues. After NOTIFICATION_MAX_ATTEMPTS the row becomes failed and stays visible. When no SMTP account is configured the row stays queued and no attempt is used. NOTIFICATIONS_ENABLED false turns the feature off for every tenant. A recipient with no email produces a skipped row so the trigger is still visible.

nodes.label: Notification dedupe_key
nodes.rationale: dedupe_key is unique. A trigger that fires twice, such as close-day catch-up, a double submit, or an admin re-approving, queues one message, not two. Defaulter mail is once per student per calendar month.

nodes.label: Notification triggers
nodes.rationale: Kinds are lecture_cancelled, proxy_assigned, shift_request, shift_decision, booking_request, booking_decision, not_marked_digest, defaulter and test. Booking triggers follow the master enabled switch and require capability bookings. The not-marked digest and defaulter alerts run after the nightly close-day. Defaulters use ATTENDANCE_THRESHOLD_PERCENT. Each trigger has its own switch; enabled turns the whole institution off.

nodes.label: SMTP account selection
nodes.rationale: Mail prefers the institution account on the settings page. The password is Fernet-encrypted with SETTINGS_ENCRYPTION_KEY, else FACE_TEMPLATE_KEY, else a key derived from SECRET_KEY. Rotating the key in use makes stored passwords unreadable. Otherwise the server SMTP environment variables are used, the same ones the alert handler uses. The API never returns the password, only has_password.
